title: What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by
question:
What is the Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) in the school administered by an administrator whose first name is Alusine. List the district code of the school.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12) = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` * 100%

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    f.XCL_020 AS Percent_Eligible_Free_K12,
    s.XCL_043 AS District_Code
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_041
WHERE 
    s.XCL_045 = 'Alusine'
